title.narrative: Programa de Fortalecimiento la Poltica Pblica y la Gestin Fiscal para la Atencin de la Crisis Sanitaria y Econmica Causada por la COVID-19 en Barbados
Programme to Strengthen Public Policy and Fiscal Management in Response to the Health and Economic Crisis Caused by COVID-19 in Barbados

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es fortalecer la eficiencia, la eficacia y la equidad de la poltica fiscal y la gestin para abordar la crisis de salud y las consecuencias econmicas de COVID-19, a travs del diseo y la implementacin de medidas de polticas efectivas y fiscalmente responsables. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) asegurar la disponibilidad oportuna de recursos pblicos para abordar la emergencia de salud causada por COVID-19; (ii) fortalecer el papel anticclico de la poltica fiscal a travs de la proteccin temporal del empleo y los ingresos de los hogares vulnerables durante la crisis econmica y de salud; (iii) apoyar la provisin efectiva y continua de bienes y servicios esenciales a travs de polticas fiscales y medidas de gestin; y (iv) promover la recuperacin econmica y fiscal.

The overall objective of the programme is to strengthen the efficiency, efficacy and equity of fiscal policy and management to address the health crisis and economic consequences of COVID-19, through the design and implementation of effective and fiscally responsible policy measures. Specific objectives are: (i) ensure timely availability of public resources to address the health emergency caused by COVID-19; (ii) strengthen the counter-cyclical role of fiscal policy through the temporary protection of employment and income of vulnerable households during the health and economic crisis; (iii) support the effective and continuous provision of essential goods and services through fiscal policy and management measures; and (iv) promote economic and fiscal recovery.
